Image Description: This black-and-white photograph captures a classic cruiser-style motorcycle parked in front of a brick building. The motorcycle, positioned on the left side of the frame, features a large windshield, chrome detailing, dual headlights, and saddlebags mounted on either side of the rear wheel. A helmet rests on the seat, suggesting the rider may have recently dismounted or is temporarily away. The bike is angled slightly toward the viewer, with its kickstand deployed to keep it upright.
